title: you are suspicious
description: this resource pack is for those who love the rock meme
body: Tired of the same old purple flashes lighting up your sky? Experience the weather phenomenon you truly deserve. This resource pack completely replaces the standard "End Flash" (Zarnitsa Kraya) with the legendary "rock" meme — featuring the iconic face of Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson himself. Now, every 30 seconds when the End decides to remind you of its existence, instead of boring purple lighting, the heavens are illuminated by that gaze of pure, unfiltered emotion. Why stare at mundane particles when the sky can be graced by the most powerful meme in history? Each flash lasts 5-19 seconds of glorious, rock-filled skies that will completely transform your End dimension experience.
